note: Comanche County (TX) does not publish a zoning layer; Texas counties generally do not zone. The City of Comanche, the county seat and largest city, publishes its Land Use and Zoning Map only as a PDF (media/121) and its ordinance as a PDF (media/131). No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning polygons found for the county or its towns (De Leon, Gustine). The county's ArcGIS Online map (services5.arcgis.com, Comanche_County__Texas_Map_WFL1) holds precincts, boundary, polling places and addresses only, no zoning.
